applied_groups.reply: Wait for the one-hour lock to expire, then sign in once with the correct password; the lock clears on its own.
users: I typed my password wrong too many times and now the account says it is locked for an hour.
After several failed password attempts my account is now locked and says to wait an hour.

applied_groups.reply: Verify your identity with your recovery phone number, then replace the old work email in account settings.
users: I changed jobs and my old work email no longer receives the sign-in verification messages.
My previous employer's email address is on the account, so the verification codes never reach me.

applied_groups.reply: Confirm the security review from that email, then set a new password and review your recent sign-in history.
users: I got an email saying my account was suspended after a suspicious login from another country.
An alert said my account got suspended because someone logged in from abroad.

applied_groups.reply: Allow cookies for our site in that browser so the device verification can be saved, then verify it once more.
users: Every time I sign in on my new laptop it asks me to verify the device again, in a loop.
The new laptop makes me confirm the device over and over whenever I log in.

applied_groups.reply: Sign out, then sign in with the email that owns the workspace you need; accounts are not merged automatically.
users: I have two accounts with different emails and I'm signed into the wrong one.
I own two accounts under separate email addresses and ended up logged into the other one.

applied_groups.reply: Turn off the VPN for the first sign-in so the location can be confirmed, then you can use it again.
users: After I turned on a VPN the site keeps rejecting my login as unusual activity.
With my VPN switched on, every login attempt is blocked as suspicious.

applied_groups.reply: Request reactivation within 90 days of closure through the reactivation form; after that the account cannot be restored.
users: My account was closed for inactivity and I want to get back in.
You closed my account because I hadn't used it in a while; how do I reopen it?

capstone_groups.reply: Update the app to the latest version and clear its stored session, then sign in again.
users: The mobile app keeps saying my session expired right after I sign in.
Right after logging in on my phone, the app tells me my session has ended.
On the phone app I get signed out immediately with a session expired message.

capstone_groups.reply: Wait for the review decision email, which arrives within two business days; no action is needed until then.
users: I was told my account is under review and I can't access anything.
My account is locked while it is being reviewed and I cannot open anything.

capstone_groups.reply: Sign out of the desktop app completely, then sign in with the browser link it opens instead of typing the password.
users: I can sign in on the website but the desktop app says my credentials are invalid.

capstone_groups.reply: Report the unauthorized change through the account recovery form so support can restore your original email.
users: Someone else changed the email on my account and I can't get in anymore.
My login email was changed by somebody else and now I'm locked out.

applied_groups.reply: Refunds post five to ten business days after the return is received; check that the return was marked received.
users: I returned the headphones two weeks ago and still haven't seen the refund.
Two weeks after sending back the headphones there is still no refund on my card.

applied_groups.reply: The bank redirects refunds for closed cards to your account; contact your bank with the refund reference.
users: The refund went to a card I already cancelled.
My refund was sent to a card that I had already closed.

applied_groups.reply: Send the cancellation confirmation date so billing can refund any charge made after that date.
users: I cancelled my plan but was charged for another month anyway.
Even after cancelling the subscription I was billed for one more month.

applied_groups.reply: Downgrades apply a prorated credit to your next invoice rather than a card refund.
users: I downgraded halfway through the year and expected some money back.
I moved to a cheaper plan mid-year and thought I would get part of the fee back.

applied_groups.reply: Pending means the payment processor has not settled it yet; allow up to ten business days before escalating.
users: My refund was approved but the status says pending for over a week.
The refund is approved yet it has shown pending for more than seven days.

applied_groups.reply: Upload your tax exemption certificate so billing can refund the tax and exempt future orders.
users: The store charged tax on an order that should have been tax-exempt.
Tax was added to my purchase although my organization is exempt.

applied_groups.reply: Request that the overpayment be refunded or kept as credit on the account, and include both payment references.
users: An old invoice was paid twice by our accounts team.
Our finance team accidentally settled the same old invoice two times.

capstone_groups.reply: Give your bank the refund reference number from the confirmation email so they can trace the incoming credit.
users: The refund shows as completed but my bank says nothing arrived.
My bank cannot find the refund that your site marks as completed.
The refund status is complete, but no money has shown up in my account.

capstone_groups.reply: Store credit refunds can be converted to the original payment method once, within 30 days, on request.
users: I got a refund in store credit but wanted it back on my card.
You gave me store credit as the refund, but I want the money on my card.

capstone_groups.reply: Payments made on the due date can take a day to post; request removal of the late fee with the payment date.
users: I was charged a late fee even though I paid on the due date.

capstone_groups.reply: Set the new card as the default payment method; this renewal can be moved to it if you ask within seven days.
users: The subscription renewed on my old card after I added a new one.
My renewal was charged to the card I replaced instead of my new one.

applied_groups.reply: Open the order's tracking page to see the latest carrier scan; late parcels usually update within one business day.
users: My parcel was supposed to arrive yesterday and there is no delivery update.
The parcel was due yesterday but the tracking shows nothing new.

applied_groups.reply: Check with neighbors and any safe place, then report the missing parcel within 48 hours so a claim can start.
users: It says delivered but nothing is at my door.
Tracking claims the package was delivered, yet there is no package here.

applied_groups.reply: Items can ship separately; check the order page for a second tracking number before reporting missing items.
users: Only one of the three items in my order arrived.
I ordered three items and only a single one showed up.

applied_groups.reply: Processing longer than five days means a stock delay; the order page shows the new dispatch estimate.
users: The order still says processing and I placed it a week ago.
It has been a week and my order is still stuck in processing.

applied_groups.reply: Rebook delivery or choose a pickup point using the reference printed on the card.
users: The delivery driver left a card saying they couldn't deliver.
A courier left a note that the delivery attempt failed.

applied_groups.reply: Parcels are returned after failed delivery attempts; you can reorder or request a refund from the order page.
users: My order was marked returned to sender and I don't know why.
The shipment went back to the sender and nobody told me the reason.

applied_groups.reply: Report the wrong delivery from your order page; a return label is provided and your correct order is resent.
users: I received someone else's order instead of mine.
The box I got contains another customer's order, not mine.

capstone_groups.reply: Repeated date changes mean the carrier is rerouting the parcel; the tracking page shows the current hub.
users: The estimated delivery date moved back twice this week.
My delivery estimate has been pushed later two times in the same week.
The expected arrival keeps slipping; it changed twice in a few days.

capstone_groups.reply: Shipping speed cannot change after dispatch; for undelivered orders, contact the carrier about express redelivery.
users: I need the order before Friday; can it be sped up?
Is there a way to get this order faster so it arrives by Friday?

capstone_groups.reply: The parcel is legally delivered once signed for; arrange collection with your neighbor when they return.
users: A neighbor signed for my parcel and now they're away.

capstone_groups.reply: Pre-orders ship on the release date shown on the product page; you'll get tracking once it ships.
users: My pre-order still has no shipping date.
There is still no ship date for the item I pre-ordered.

applied_groups.reply: Reset links last 30 minutes; request a new link and use it straight away.
users: The password reset link in the email says it has expired.
When I open the reset email the link tells me it has timed out.

applied_groups.reply: Each reset link works once; request a new link if you did not finish setting the password.
users: The reset link says it was already used.
Clicking the reset link shows a message that it has been used before.

applied_groups.reply: Your browser may be filling in the old password; clear the saved password and type the new one.
users: After resetting, it still says my password is wrong.
I changed my password with the reset form but login still rejects it.

applied_groups.reply: Use the account recovery form to verify your identity and change the email before resetting.
users: I want to reset my password but I no longer have access to my email.
I need a new password, but I can't get into the mailbox the reset would go to.

applied_groups.reply: Sign out of the mobile app and sign in again with the new password to refresh its stored login.
users: I reset my password on the website but the mobile app still asks for the old one.
The website accepts my new password while the phone app keeps wanting the previous one.

applied_groups.reply: Someone may be requesting resets with your email; ignore the emails and turn on two-step verification.
users: I get a reset email every morning that I didn't ask for.
Password reset emails keep arriving daily even though I never requested them.

applied_groups.reply: A forced reset follows a security alert or a password found in a data breach; choose a new unique password.
users: Today the site made me pick a new password without any warning.
Without warning the site forced me to choose a different password this morning.

capstone_groups.reply: Resetting the password ends every session for safety; sign in again on each device.
users: I set a new password but now all my devices are signed out.
Changing my password logged me out on every device I own.
Since I updated my password, my laptop, phone and tablet all lost their sessions.

capstone_groups.reply: Change the language in account preferences, then request the reset email again.
users: The reset email arrived in a language I can't read.
The password reset message came in a language I don't understand.

capstone_groups.reply: Add a password from security settings while signed in with Google; no reset link is needed.
users: I want to set a password but I only ever signed in with Google.

capstone_groups.reply: Open the most recent email only; requesting several links invalidates the earlier ones.
users: The reset email says the link is invalid right after I receive it.
The link in the reset email is rejected as invalid the moment it arrives.

applied_groups.reply: Spreadsheet export is included in the Standard plan and above.
users: Which plan lets me export my data to a spreadsheet?
Which subscription includes exporting data as a spreadsheet?

applied_groups.reply: The Team plan includes 1 TB of shared storage, and more can be added in 100 GB blocks.
users: How much storage do I get with the team plan?
What is the storage allowance on the team subscription?

applied_groups.reply: The desktop app works offline and syncs changes when you reconnect; the web app needs a connection.
users: Does the app work without an internet connection?
Can I keep using the app while I'm offline?

applied_groups.reply: Deleted files stay in the trash for 30 days before they are removed permanently.
users: How long do you keep deleted files?
How many days do deleted files stay recoverable?

applied_groups.reply: Annual billing costs the same features as monthly but saves two months of fees.
users: What's the difference between the monthly and annual plans?
How do the annual and monthly subscriptions differ?

applied_groups.reply: Data is stored in the region chosen at sign-up; enterprise plans can pick a specific region.
users: Where is my data stored?
In which region do you keep my data?

applied_groups.reply: Single files can be up to 5 GB on paid plans and 250 MB on the free plan.
users: Is there a limit on file upload size?
What is the largest file I can upload?

capstone_groups.reply: The free plan keeps seven days of version history; paid plans keep one year.
users: Does the free plan include version history?
Is version history available without paying?
Can free accounts see earlier versions of a file?

capstone_groups.reply: The mobile app supports tablets on both iOS and Android with the same features as phones.
users: Is there a mobile app for tablets?
Do you have an app I can use on my tablet?

capstone_groups.reply: Registered nonprofits receive 30 percent off any paid plan after verification.
users: Do you offer a nonprofit discount?

capstone_groups.reply: Spreadsheet import is available on all plans from the import menu in any project.
users: Can I import data from a spreadsheet?
Is it possible to bring in data from a spreadsheet file?

applied_groups.reply: Update to the latest version; if it still closes, send the app version and the crash log from settings.
users: The app closes as soon as I open it.
Right after launching, the app shuts down by itself.

applied_groups.reply: Cancel the stuck upload and retry on a stable connection; large files resume from where they stopped.
users: An upload has been stuck at 99 percent for an hour.
My file upload has been frozen near the end for an hour.

applied_groups.reply: Run the connection test from the help menu and send the result if loading stays slow.
users: Pages take a very long time to load.
Every page loads extremely slowly for me.

applied_groups.reply: Clear the app cache from settings, then restart the app to reload the updated files.
users: After the latest update the screen is completely blank.
Since updating the app I only see an empty white screen.

applied_groups.reply: Rebuild the search index from settings; new files can take a few minutes to appear.
users: The search bar returns no results for files I know exist.
Searching finds nothing even for files that are definitely there.

applied_groups.reply: The app needs the operating system version listed on the requirements page; update the system if possible.
users: The app says my device is not supported.
I'm told my phone is not compatible with the app.

applied_groups.reply: Message attachments are limited to 25 MB; share larger files as links instead.
users: I can't attach files larger than a few megabytes to messages.
Attachments over a few megabytes fail when I send a message.

capstone_groups.reply: Reset shortcuts to default in the editor preferences; another app may also be capturing the same keys.
users: My keyboard shortcuts stopped working in the editor.
Shortcut keys no longer do anything inside the editor.
The editor ignores my keyboard shortcuts now.

capstone_groups.reply: Check that your computer's date and time are correct; wrong clocks cause certificate warnings.
users: I see a certificate warning when opening the website.
My browser shows a security certificate warning for your site.

capstone_groups.reply: Set the document language to match the text in the language menu so the right dictionary is used.
users: Spell check underlines every word in my document.

capstone_groups.reply: Re-enable the extension from the browser's extensions page; updates sometimes turn it off.
users: The browser extension disappeared after an update.
After updating the browser, your extension is gone.

instruction_sets.evaluation_serialization: expected.response is the exact two-line assistant content

documents.text: Account recovery uses the recovery page. Verify your identity before you change the account email.
Refund status appears in the billing settlement record. A pending refund shows a settlement reference.
A password reset link works once and stops working after one hour. Request one fresh reset link and discard the old link.
Order tracking shows carrier scans. A parcel without a recent scan can receive a carrier trace.
Sign-in security codes depend on an accurate device clock. Synchronize the clock before you retry the code.
Invoices list service lines and totals. Send a duplicate service line on an invoice to billing review.
A refund for a returned parcel starts after the parcel is scanned at the returns desk. Check the parcel scan, not the refund page.
Expired passwords must be changed at sign-in. When your password has expired, the sign-in page asks you to choose a new password.

queries.text: How do I get back into my account and change the account email?
Where do I see the status of a pending refund for a returned parcel?
What do I do when the password reset link for my account no longer works?
My parcel has no recent tracking scan from the carrier.
My sign-in code is rejected at the sign-in page.
The invoice shows the same service line twice.
